topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I walk through the familiar halls of the school, the echoes of the past mingling with the present. The sight of the classroom, unchanged after all these years, brings a heavy weight to my steps. I hadn't anticipated this, seeing Mr. Thompson's name still on the door. He's the same teacher, kind and patient, whose gentle encouragement once guided me. Now, I stand outside, watching my child enter that room, the door closing behind them with a finality that feels almost too fitting. It's a bittersweet loop, one I didn’t foresee repeating.
